decision.final_title: ChampHLA: a fail-closed, pre-registered benchmark of plurality voting across short-read HLA class I callers
decision.running_title: Fail-closed benchmark of HLA caller voting
decision.condition: 'pre-registered' is used only once the frozen confirmatory extension, made under the publicly deposited amended pre-registration, is reported. Until then the current title 'ChampHLA: a fail-closed benchmark of plurality voting across short-read HLA class I callers' is kept.
decision.rationale: Names the method (ChampHLA), the design property that distinguishes the study (fail-closed reporting and, after the extension, pre-registration), the question (plurality voting across callers) and the scope (short-read data, HLA class I). It makes no superiority, equivalence or clinical claim, and is within the 20-word venue limit.
